title: Sigrid Possible NDEs 5404 NDE 5404
content: During my out of body experience, I was undergoing a surgery on my tonsils. I heard everything, but; I could not defend myself against someone, I could not move, nor could I make myself understood. I felt panic and fear. Suddenly I saw myself sitting in a big chair, looking down from the ceiling and I heard everything that was said during my surgery. The next day, during hospital rounds, I told people, including my parents, about this event but nobody believed me. Years after that experience, I asked a technical surgery nurse if this tonsil surgery would be done in a chair. She answered yes. This was like a confirmation for me that my experience from a long time ago was real and not an illusion. At the birth of my daughter, they had to remove the placenta because it didn't detach by itself. During the anesthesia while under the mask, I had another NDE. First, I saw myself move in a spiral towards a really bright light, and, at the same time, I saw my life running backwards at a fast speed. I also saw, or rather I felt very emotional remembrances and some of the experiences and very emotional reactions of people near to me. Everything happened very fast. When I arrived in this bright light, I was very warmly welcomed by a white light soul. I was aware that I will die. Suddenly, I remembered that I have just given birth to a child, and that I cannot die in that very moment. In the same moment when I was thinking this, or maybe the light soul said this to me, I don't remember exactly which, I was catapulted backwards through the tunnel and in the next moment, I awoke. I remember very clearly, that the midwife looked at me in a very peculiar/dismayed way.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Described moving 'in a spiral towards a really bright light' and later being 'catapulted backwards through the tunnel.'

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'white light soul' that welcomed the experiencer.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Two events: tonsil surgery (OBE) and anesthesia during manual placenta removal after childbirth.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Two separate experiences reported: (1) OBE during tonsil surgery; (2) tunnel/bright light with life review during anesthesia after childbirth, followed by rapid return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: In the second experience, tunnel/spiral toward bright light occurred simultaneously with a fast backward life review; return was described as being 'catapulted backwards through the tunnel.'
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Multiple NDE-like episodes across two medical events (tonsil surgery and childbirth anesthesia).
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Tunnel movement toward light and life review occurred at the same time.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: First event emphasized inability to move or communicate while hearing everything during surgery, followed by viewing self from the ceiling; later external confirmation that tonsil surgery is done in a chair.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Suddenly I saw myself sitting in a big chair, looking down from the ceiling and I heard everything that was said during my surgery.”; “First, I saw myself move in a spiral towards a really bright light, and, at the same time, I saw my life running backwards at a fast speed.”; “When I arrived in this bright light, I was very warmly welcomed by a white light soul.”; “I was catapulted backwards through the tunnel and in the next moment, I awoke.”
